pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: YOU LOOK TIRED. HOW ‘BOUT GET SOME COFFEE?

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: NAW, IT’S COOL. GONNA TAKE A LITTLE NAP INSTEAD

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: GUESS I'LL BE ON MY WAY THEN.

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: I DID HEAR SOMETHING. HEAR IT WAS ACTUALLY ARTHUR WHO GAVE ‘EM THE WORD.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: SOONER OR LATER, I'M GOING TO HAVE TO SETTLE WITH HIM.

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: YOU STACKIN' UP ENEMIES IN THE FAMILY, ASH.

pages.speaker: character4
pages.text: APPRECIATE IT IF YOU COULD OPEN THE DOOR A BIT MORE GENTLY.

pages.speaker: character4
pages.text: DON'T WANT TO DISTURB MY ORCHIDS
